menu.file.save_as.does: Saves under a new name or format.

menu.file.save_a_copy.does: Saves a copy and keeps working on the original.

menu.file.revert.does: Returns to the last saved version.

menu.file.place.does: Imports an image or file into the document.

menu.file.export.export_for_screens.does: Exports artboards/assets at several sizes and formats.

menu.file.export.export_as.does: Exports artwork as PNG, JPG, SVG, etc.

menu.file.package.does: Collects the file with its fonts and linked images.

menu.file.document_setup.does: Changes artboard size, units and bleed.

menu.edit.paste_in_front.does: Pastes directly above the selection, same position.

menu.edit.paste_in_back.does: Pastes directly below the selection, same position.

menu.edit.paste_in_place.does: Pastes at the exact position it was copied from.

menu.edit.edit_colors.recolor_artwork.does: Changes the colours of the selected artwork.

menu.object.transform.move.does: Moves the selection by an exact distance.

menu.object.transform.rotate.does: Rotates the selection by an exact angle.

menu.object.transform.reflect.does: Mirrors the selection across an axis.

menu.object.transform.scale.does: Scales the selection by an exact percentage.

menu.object.transform.transform_each.does: Transforms each selected object around its own centre.

menu.object.arrange.bring_to_front.does: Moves the selection to the top of the stack.

menu.object.arrange.bring_forward.does: Moves the selection up one level.

menu.object.arrange.send_backward.does: Moves the selection down one level.

menu.object.arrange.send_to_back.does: Moves the selection to the bottom of the stack.

menu.object.lock.selection.does: Locks the selected objects so they can't be edited.

menu.object.expand.does: Converts strokes, fills, and effects into editable shapes.

menu.object.path.join.does: Joins two endpoints into one path.

menu.object.path.outline_stroke.does: Turns a stroke into a filled shape.

menu.object.path.offset_path.does: Creates a copy of the path offset by a set distance.

menu.object.path.simplify.does: Reduces the number of anchor points.

menu.object.pattern.make.does: Turns the selection into a repeating pattern.

menu.object.blend.make.does: Creates intermediate shapes between two objects.

menu.object.image_trace.make.does: Converts a raster image into vector shapes.

menu.object.clipping_mask.make.does: Uses the top object as a mask for the others.

menu.object.compound_path.make.does: Combines paths into one compound path (holes cut out).

path: Update Legacy Type on a Path

menu.type.create_outlines.does: Converts text into editable vector shapes.

menu.select.all.does: Selects every object on the artboard.

menu.effect.distort_transform.pucker_blo.does: Pulls anchor points in or out to make petal or star shapes.

menu.effect.distort_transform.transform.does: Moves, scales, rotates or copies with a live effect.

menu.effect.stylize.drop_shadow.does: Adds a drop shadow to the selection.

menu.effect.stylize.round_corners.does: Rounds all corners of a shape with a live effect.

menu.effect.stylize.scribble.does: Gives artwork a hand-drawn scribble look.

menu.window.appearance.does: Shows or hides the Appearance panel.

menu.window.gradient.does: Shows or hides the Gradient panel.

menu.window.layers.does: Shows or hides the Layers panel.

menu.window.libraries.does: Shows or hides the CC Libraries panel.

menu.window.pathfinder.does: Shows or hides the Pathfinder panel (unite, minus front, intersect...).

menu.window.properties.does: Shows or hides the Properties panel.

menu.window.stroke.does: Shows or hides the Stroke panel.

menu.window.swatches.does: Shows or hides the Swatches panel.
